title: O-Sensing: Operator Sensing for Interaction Geometry and Symmetries
summary: We ask whether the Hamiltonian, interaction geometry, and symmetries of a quantum many-body system can be inferred from a few low-lying eigenstates without knowing which sites interact with each other. Directly solving the eigenvalue equations imposes constraints that yield a highly degenerate subspace of candidate operators, where the local Hamiltonian is hidden among an extensive family of conserved quantities, obscuring the interaction geometry.
